evals.name: tailored-with-photo
evals.prompt: This is my wife's LinkedIn profile export (linkedin-profile.pdf) and her photo (photo.jpg). She wants to apply for this: <posting URL> — make her a CV PDF tailored to that posting. Include the photo and the GDPR consent line, it's a Polish employer. English. Her email is <email>, phone <phone>, LinkedIn <profile URL>. The '25 years' in her summary is right — it includes paid training before her first listed role.
evals.expected_output: A two-page-max A4 PDF CV tailored to the Capgemini posting: single column, photo top-right, consent footer, standard section headings, embedded fonts, extractable text; plus a short tailoring report listing requirement coverage and honest gaps, and a reusable cv-master.yaml. Contact line shows email and phone; summary keeps 25 years.
expectations: A PDF file is delivered in outputs
PDF is at most 2 pages
Page size is A4
Text layer is extractable and contains the candidate's name
Standard section headings present as standalone lines, Experience before Education before Languages
All fonts embedded
No text smaller than 6.5 pt (hidden-keyword smell)
Body text at least 9 pt (median char size)
No placeholders or template artefacts in the PDF text
No first-person voice in the CV
No tools from the posting that are absent from the LinkedIn profile (Azure DevOps, UML, BPMN) appear in the CV
All text extracts as Unicode via pdfminer (no private-use glyphs for digits/ligatures)
Key words are not split under pdfminer layout analysis (e.g. 'Invest igat or')
Month-year dates are present (e.g. Jul 2004)
LinkedIn profile URL is a clickable link annotation
PDF metadata Title and Author are set
A reusable structured master file (cv-master.yaml) is delivered
Size under 2 MB
Email and phone from the user appear in the PDF
Summary keeps the candidate's confirmed '25 years'
Photo is embedded as an image
GDPR consent line present
A tailoring report (not just NOTES) lists honest gaps incl. Azure DevOps
Posting vocabulary mirrored where true: 'stakeholder' appears in the CV
German language shown as native/C2 (posting must-have)
